evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, run() still collapses a None result from drain() into {"status":"drained"} with exit 0. Since drain() returns None on early non-start cases such as clone-fetch failure or tick-lock refusal, the JSON artifact falsely reports a completed drain and loses the deferral reason; adjacent paths already use 'deferred'/'busy' statuses, so this is an ordinary result-reporting defect rather than a new requirement.
